rows.grounds: past participle of pīḍ in nominative plural

items.question: What condition do beings undergo within the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams?
premises: Beings are described as tormented within them.
items.inference: The verse states that beings suffer torment in those womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The exact beings referred to are not specified in the verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
